description:
PrepperBase is your calm, no-hype guide to survival skills, bushcraft, and emergency preparedness. We teach practical methods you can practice today: fire starting, water purification, first aid basics, shelter building, and navigation, so your 72-hour kit, EDC, and bug out bag actually work when it counts. Whether you’re into bushcraft camping, planning for urban survival during a blackout, or going offgrid, we focus on skills over stuff with field-tested tips, clear checklists, and honest gear reviews.

Weekly videos on:
- Build and maintain a 72-hour kit, get-home bag, and vehicle kit
- Bushcraft survival: fire in wet conditions, tarp & A-frame shelters, campcraft
- Urban & disaster preparedness: blackout prep, comms, water/food storage
- First aid fundamentals and safety best practices (training-oriented)
- Prepping tips: smart supply lists, budget vs premium gear, seasonal swaps
- Wilderness skills: navigation, knife/axe use, camp cooking & mindset

#prepper #survival #bushcraft
